paper_record.title: Coupled Spin-Density-Wave and Bond-Order Driven Metal-Insulator Transition in Altermagnetic CsCr$_2$S$_2$O
paper_record.abstract: A metal-insulator transition (MIT) driven by bond order (BO) coupled with a secondary spin-density wave (SDW) is identified in CsCr$_2$S$_2$O. Such coupling is enabled as a result of the broken time-reversal symmetry due to the pre-existing C-type antiferromagnetic (C-AFM) order. First-principles calculations reveal an orbital-selective physics that Cr-$d_{yz}$ orbitals form local moments and establish the altermagnetic order, while the Cr-$d_{xz}$ orbitals remain metallic and hybridize with S-$p_z$. Thus the low-energy physics is governed by the Cr-$d_{xz}$ and S-$p_z$ orbitals. On-site interactions then enhance a secondary SDW ($s$SDW) instability of the itinerant $d_{xz}$ electrons, which couples to the Cr-$d_{xz}$-S-$p_z$ bonding order. The resulting coupled $s$SDW-BO simultaneously produces experimentally observed structural distortion, charge disproportionation, local Cr-moment modulation, and gap opening. Our results establish an orbital-selective mechanism upon which pre-existing altermagnetism and electronic correlations cooperate to drive a structural MIT.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 揭示了CsCr2S2O中由预存共线反铁磁序激活的、二次自旋密度波与键序耦合驱动的金属-绝缘体相变机制。
one_sentence_summary.en: Identifies a metal-insulator transition in CsCr2S2O driven by a secondary spin-density wave coupled with bond order, enabled by pre-existing altermagnetism.

problem.zh: 阐明CsCr2S2O中近室温结构畸变与金属-绝缘体相变的微观机制，以及它们与预存磁序的关系。
problem.en: Clarifying the microscopic mechanism of the near-room-temperature structural distortion and metal-insulator transition in CsCr2S2O and their relationship with the pre-existing magnetic order.

approach.zh: 结合第一性原理密度泛函理论计算、紧束缚模型、有限温度声子计算以及随机相位近似易受性分析。
approach.en: Combining first-principles DFT calculations, tight-binding modeling, finite-temperature phonon calculations, and RPA susceptibility analysis.

main_takeaway.zh: 轨道选择性使得局域轨道维持磁背景，而巡游轨道上的自旋密度波涨落与金属-配体键序耦合，共同驱动了相变。
main_takeaway.en: Orbital selectivity partitions the localized and itinerant states, allowing spin-density wave fluctuations in the itinerant channel to couple with bond order and drive the transition.

why_it_matters.zh: 提出了一种由预存磁序和电子关联协同驱动结构相变与金属-绝缘体相变的新型轨道选择机制。
why_it_matters.en: Proposes a novel orbital-selective mechanism where pre-existing magnetism and electronic correlations cooperate to drive structural and metal-insulator transitions.

reason.zh: 成功解释了CsCr2S2O中磁性、结构和输运相变的耦合机制，并指出了其与钒基体系的差异。
reason.en: Successfully explains the coupling mechanism of magnetic, structural, and transport transitions in CsCr2S2O, highlighting the difference from V-based systems.

reason.zh: 该研究探讨了当前热点的交错磁体中的新型相变机制，具有较强的物理通用性。
reason.en: The study discusses a novel transition mechanism in currently hot altermagnetic systems, offering broad physical insights.
